LIFE IS A ROAD.
ENJOY THE CURVES

GASOLINE
IN MY VEINS

NOT ALL WHO
WANDER ARE LOST.
SOME ARE DRIVING

The best therapy:
a road and
good music

car appeared

Money can't buy
happiness, but
it buys spare parts

The sweetest sound:
a cold start

Mercedes Jellinek

were built

was made until 2003

were built

a DeLorean

DS rode on

Life's too short
for boring cars

The best memories
are made
on the road

A wheel means
an adventure

Morning smell
of gasoline

All roads lead
to the garage

Clean car,
clear conscience

Don't rush.
The road isn't
going anywhere
Buckle up! {r}

Manual gearbox:
the best
anti-theft system

Happiness: an
empty road and
a full tank

The garage is
my happy place

I love the smell
of new tires

Let's drive
anywhere

Driving is
a calling

Traffic jam?
Play your
favorite song
The road heals

Cold start,
warm heart

A car understands
only love
and oil

Racing is chess
at speed

Best sound: the
click of a seatbelt

Check your
tire pressure

Not every hero
wears a cape.
Some wear overalls

Cars don't age.
They become
classics

Retro is not
an age.
It's a style

Classics never
go out of style

More revs,
more smiles

Drive so they
wait for you
at home

Watch out for
pedestrians {g}

Use your
turn signal

If it started,
it's a good day

Winter tip:
good tires

Road trip:
the best vacation

The best tuning:
driver experience

A favorite car is
part of the family

My garage,
my rules

Rear wheel drive
is fun

All wheel drive
is freedom

Wind in your face,
road under
the wheels

Speed belongs
on the track

Car meet this
weekend?

My second home
has four wheels

A drive before
bedtime?

It's not an oil
stain. It's history

A reliable car
means calm sleep

The best car is
the one in
your garage

The road
is calling {y}

Oil, water,
let's go

A car is freedom
on wheels
Visiting someone?

High beams only
on empty roads
Lights on?

Mechanics is magic
you can touch

Weekends are
for driving

Love for cars
runs in
the family

Son, this is
a carburetor.
Remember it

Garage hangouts:
the best club

The wheel: the
best stress relief

Not just a car.
A legend

Cars are like
people: they
love care

Round the
block?

Every scratch
is a memory

The best navigator
sits beside you

The road starts
with a turn
of the key

Every great trip
starts at
the gas station

Quiet road,
loud music

Favorite sound:
the turn signal
ticking

Garage time
is me time

Washed and
waxed {b}

Petrolhead
and proud

Road trip
snacks: packed

Six cylinders,
one big smile

Fasten your
seat belts

The open road
is calling

Keep calm
and change gear

Old cars,
new memories

Life is better
in the fast lane.
Legally

Drive safe,
arrive happy
